evidence.ACL: Mild signal abnormality involving the ACL ligament at the posterior insertion to the femur, likely related to a mild sprain.
evidence.Lateral Meniscus: Complex multidirectional tear involving the posterior, body and anterior horn of the lateral meniscus.
evidence.Lateral OA: Focal high to full-thickness cartilage loss in the lateral femoral condyle and tibia posteriorly.
evidence.PF OA: Mild cartilage loss in the patellofemoral cartilage with thinning of the patellar cartilage inferiorly.
evidence.Effusion: Small to moderate right knee joint effusion
